| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| cell | grid cell, source $A$ / chunker $M$ |
| source $A$ | source alphabet size |
| $M$ | chunker boundary-mask bits |
| $N$ | chunks in the pattern |
| $D$ | distinct chunks |
| $N/D$ | mean occurrences per distinct chunk |
| $H_0$ | order-0 empirical entropy of the pattern, bits/chunk |
| mean | mean over seeds 1 and 2 (all table values) |
| Table 2 values | compressed size, bits/chunk; bold = smallest in the column |
| *best AMC-T*, *best AMC-G* | smallest variant of that coder in the cell |
| *vs MCD* | size of that variant relative to MCD |
| encode, decode | median time of 5 runs |
